rad.5.coronary-ct.title: CAD-RADS 2.0 stenosis key
rad.5.coronary-ct.scope: Apply after reviewing all evaluable segments. Plaque burden, HRP, physiology and other modifiers are separate; use the complete report template for those rules.

rows.criteria: No coronary plaque or stenosis.
rows.report_note: Do not append a P category.

rows.criteria: 1–24% stenosis, or plaque without narrowing.
rows.report_note: Describe the plaque.

rows.criteria: 25–49% stenosis.
rows.report_note: Record the dominant lesion.

rows.criteria: 50–69% stenosis.
rows.report_note: Correlate with symptoms and any physiology.

rows.criteria: 70–99% stenosis in one or two vessels.
rows.report_note: Specify vessel and segment.

rows.criteria: Left main ≥50%, or severe three-vessel disease.
rows.report_note: State the qualifying anatomy.

rows.criteria: At least one total occlusion.
rows.report_note: Describe occlusion and distal vessel.

rows.criteria: Relevant segment non-evaluable; no ≥50% stenosis shown elsewhere.
rows.report_note: If ≥50% is demonstrated elsewhere, retain that category and add N.

rad.5.prostate-mri.title: PI-RADS v2.1 zonal combination rules
rad.5.prostate-mri.scope: Use diagnostic-quality T2 and DWI, with sequence scores already established. These are combination rules, not definitions of sequence scores. Mark absent or inadequate components X and use the official fallback tables.

rows.criteria: Overall category equals DWI score.
rows.report_note: DCE does not upgrade these scores.

rows.criteria: DCE negative → 3; DCE positive → 4.
rows.report_note: If DCE is unavailable, DWI determines the category.

rows.criteria: Overall category equals DWI score.
rows.report_note: Describe local extent separately.

rows.criteria: Overall category 1.
rows.report_note: A typical encapsulated nodule is assessed by T2 morphology.
The latter is the 2+1 exception.

rows.criteria: DWI ≤4 → 3; DWI 5 → 4.
rows.report_note: The latter is the 3+1 exception.

rows.criteria: Overall category equals T2 score.
rows.report_note: DCE does not determine the TZ category.

rad.5.thyroid-tirads.title: ACR TI-RADS category and size prompts
rad.5.thyroid-tirads.scope: Adult thyroid nodule framework after the five ultrasound feature scores are added. Interpret with clinical context, prior biopsy and suspicious nodes; these size prompts are not an automatic patient recommendation.

rows.criteria: No FNA or routine ultrasound follow-up under this framework.
rows.report_note: Benign category.

rows.criteria: No FNA or routine ultrasound follow-up under this framework.
rows.report_note: Not suspicious category.

rows.criteria: FNA at ≥2.5 cm; ultrasound follow-up from 1.5 to <2.5 cm.
rows.report_note: For follow-up-sized nodules: years 1, 3 and 5.

rows.criteria: FNA at ≥1.5 cm; ultrasound follow-up from 1.0 to <1.5 cm.
rows.report_note: For follow-up-sized nodules: years 1, 2, 3 and 5.

rows.criteria: FNA at ≥1.0 cm; ultrasound follow-up from 0.5 to <1.0 cm.
rows.report_note: For follow-up-sized nodules: yearly for five years.

rad.4.kidney.title: Bosniak 2019 morphological quick key
rad.4.kidney.scope: For appropriately characterised cystic renal masses with <25% enhancing tissue, after excluding other causes. This abbreviated structural key does not list every homogeneous CT/MRI benign exception; consult the full criteria for those patterns.

rows.criteria: Simple fluid, smooth wall ≤2 mm; no septa or nodules.
rows.report_note: A thin smooth wall may enhance.

rows.criteria: Up to three smooth thin (≤2 mm) septa; calcification may occur.
rows.report_note: Enhancing thin septa are allowed; see full benign exceptions.

rows.criteria: Smooth 3 mm enhancing wall/septum, or ≥4 thin enhancing septa.
rows.report_note: Check the additional MRI-defined IIF patterns.

rows.criteria: Enhancing wall/septa ≥4 mm, or irregular thickening with obtuse protrusions ≤3 mm.
rows.report_note: An enhancing nodule instead qualifies for IV.

rows.criteria: Enhancing nodule: ≥4 mm with obtuse margins, or any size with acute margins.
rows.report_note: State the nodule size and enhancement evidence.

rad.4.oncology-response.title: RECIST 1.1 response anchors
rad.4.oncology-response.scope: Use the protocol-defined target set and comparison dates. Overall response also integrates non-target disease and new lesions. Immunotherapy-specific iRECIST is a separate framework.

rows.criteria: Target lesions disappear; pathological nodes become <10 mm short axis.
rows.report_note: Non-target disease and new lesions still affect overall response.

rows.criteria: Sum decreases ≥30% from baseline.
rows.report_note: Apply confirmation requirements when the study protocol requires them.

rows.criteria: Sum increases ≥20% from nadir and by ≥5 mm absolutely.
rows.report_note: The nadir includes baseline if it is the smallest sum.

rows.criteria: Neither sufficient decrease for PR nor increase for PD.
rows.report_note: Check protocol timing and response history.

rows.criteria: Unequivocal new malignant lesion or unequivocal non-target progression can establish PD.
rows.report_note: An uncertain new finding needs resolution, not automatic progression.
